observation_operator: finite-volume top-hat reconstruction of SLABx section averages

findings.axis_attribution: downwind-only marginal clipping at ignition; crosswind and height marginal clipping are zero
findings.packet_support: SLABx itself reports a maximum puff half-length of approximately 213531 m at ignition; PRISM rectangular support is approximately 426324 m and agrees with that provider geometry for the reconstructed section
findings.early_onset: downwind clipping is already present at 1e-6 s, so simply extending the far-downwind boundary does not close the provider puff
findings.consequence_scope: For the declared fire/explosion branch, the representative event is complete for flammability even though nonflammable hydrogen inventory remains outside the finite grid.

interpretation: SLABx itself reports an extremely long finite-puff half-length for this small liquid-pool event. PRISM records that provider geometry and reconstructs the emitted inventory without clipping or setting outside mass to zero. A conservative sum of packet mole fractions outside the grid is 5.09e-5, far below the 0.04 LFL threshold, so the representative event is complete for the declared fire/explosion branch even though nonflammable inventory remains outside the finite grid. A provider-resolved validated spatial envelope or a validated liquid-pool observation operator is still required before treating the inventory ledger as spatially complete or promoting broader facility claims.
